chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn 'Amirah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
There is no worship more superior in the Presence of Allah than the chastity of the belly and the private part.
ai.seo_question: What is considered the most superior form of worship according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) elevates 'iffah' (chastity/restraint) regarding the stomach and private parts to the status of the most superior worship, emphasizing that controlling base desires is foundational to spiritual excellence. This teaching aligns with the Shia scholarly view that physical discipline is not merely asceticism but a profound act of devotion that purifies the soul and prepares it for higher spiritual states.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Mansour Bin Hazim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is none from a ‘worship’ more superior in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> than the chastity of the belly and the private part’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf ibn ‘Amirah from Mansur ibn Hazim from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘
In the sight of Allah there is no worship more virtuous than chastity in matters of stomach and genital organs.’”
